questions.title: Map Work and Tour Planning — Paris 2024 Olympics

subQuestions.questionText:
Refer to the World Time Zone map and the 'PARIS – THIRD TIME AROUND!' extract. The Summer Olympics took place in Paris, France, from 26 July to 11 August 2024.

Calculate the time difference between London and Paris at the time of the Olympic Games. (Refer to the source/image in the question paper.)
subQuestions.memoText:
Mark 1: London 0° (+1 DST) = +1; Paris +1 (+1 DST) = +2
Mark 2: Time difference = 1 hour

Final answer: 1 hour

subQuestions.questionText:
Team South Africa competed at the Paris 2024 Summer Olympics. Their flight departed from OR Tambo International Airport at 20:00 on 18 July 2024. The duration of the flight was 11 hours.

Calculate the time and date the South African team arrived in Paris.

NOTE: France practised DST at the time of the Olympic Games. (Refer to the source/image in the question paper.)
subQuestions.memoText:
Mark 1: Johannesburg +2; Paris +1 (+1 DST) = +2 → Time difference = 0 hours
Mark 2: Local time in Paris at departure = 20:00 + 0 hours = 20:00
Mark 3: Add flying time: 20:00 (+11 hours) = 07:00
Mark 4: Arrival date = 19 July 2024

Final answer: 07:00 on 19 July 2024

subQuestions.questionText: Explain ONE way in which the team members had to adjust their watches upon arrival in Paris.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answer (2 marks):
• The team had to adjust their watches ONE hour forward.
OR
• The team had no need to adjust their watches (no time difference between South Africa and France with DST).

subQuestions.label: 2.1.4(a)
subQuestions.questionText: The duration of the flight was 11 hours. Name the travel-related condition the team members suffered from after the flight.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answer (2 marks): Jet fatigue
• Also accept: Jet lag

subQuestions.label: 2.1.4(b)
subQuestions.questionText: Discuss ONE reason for your answer to QUESTION 2.1.4(a).
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answer (any ONE — 2 marks):
• It was a flight that did not cross many time zones.
• There is only one time zone difference between Johannesburg and Paris.

subQuestions.questionText: After the Olympic Games, the team members extended their stay in Europe to explore other regions of France, Italy and Spain. Name the visa required for their journey.
subQuestions.memoText: Expected answer (1 mark): Schengen visa

subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answer (any ONE — 2 marks):
• France was the first point (country) of entry into Europe.
• France is the country where they will spend most of their time.

subQuestions.questionText: Explain TWO advantages of the type of visa named in QUESTION 2.2.1.
subQuestions.memoText:

• This visa grants access to all the countries to be visited.
• It is convenient to apply for one visa that can be used for the three countries.
• It saves time to apply for a Schengen visa only instead of three separate visas.
• It saves money as only a single payment is made.
• Biometrics only need to be done once when applying for the visa.

subQuestions.questionText: The team's itinerary included a visit to the Italian coast where they planned to spend a few days at the beach. Name TWO items that the team members should have placed in the safe of the hotel room before leaving for the beach.

• Personal documentation

subQuestions.questionText:
In a paragraph, discuss THREE ways in which the team could protect themselves from exposure to the sun while at the beach.

NOTE: Use full sentences in a paragraph format.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (any THREE — 2 marks each = 6, plus 1 mark for full sentences in paragraph format):
• Take personal responsibility against sun exposure.
• Use sunblock with a high sun protection factor (SPF).
• Wear protective hats/clothing/sunglasses.
• Limit exposure to the sun during the hottest part of the day.
• Hire umbrellas or other protective structures, e.g. gazebos or tents.
• Stay hydrated.
NOTE: Award ONE mark for full sentences and paragraph format.

subQuestions.questionText: Madrid in Spain is known for its vibrant nightlife. Suggest TWO ways in which the team could ensure their safety while exploring the streets of Madrid at night.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (any TWO — 2 marks each):
• Do not walk alone — commit to staying in groups.
• Avoid poorly lit areas.
• Avoid isolated areas.
• Inform someone about their whereabouts.
• Enquire from the hotel about safe places to explore.
• Do not ask strangers for directions on the streets.
• Keep emergency contact details on a charged cell phone.
• Keep valuables out of sight / do not display cell phones.

subQuestions.questionText: Each South African team member had R50 000 spending money for the trip to the Summer Olympic Games in Paris. They exchanged their rands at OR Tambo International Airport before their flight. Give the currency code for the following currency: British pound.

Mark 2: Multiplication: €75 × 20,52
Mark 3: Final answer = R1 539,00

Final answer: R1 539,00

subQuestions.questionText: The gross domestic product is one of the main indicators to measure the wealth of a country. Explain the concept gross domestic product (GDP).
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answer (2 marks):
Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a measure of all the goods and services produced domestically over a specific time, usually in a year.

subQuestions.questionText: Discuss TWO ways how the hosting of the Olympic Games contributed to an increase in the GDP of France.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (any TWO — 2 marks each):
• The Olympic Games brought many tourists to France, resulting in an increase in foreign income earnings.
• The tourists made use of tourism products and services which generated income.
• The demand for more products and services led to an increase in entrepreneurial opportunities.
• Increased employment opportunities, improved standard of living and infrastructural development.
• The multiplier effect was set into motion.

subQuestions.memoText:

• B – Leaning Tower of Pisa

subQuestions.questionText: Each of the icons above was constructed (built) in a unique way. Discuss ONE fact of EACH of the icons with reference to their design and the way in which they were built. (Refer to the source/image in the question paper.)
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (2 marks per icon):
A – Colosseum: An ancient building with a large amphitheatre that could seat between 50 000 and 80 000 spectators; built with many levels and arches.
B – Leaning Tower of Pisa: It is a leaning (tilting) tower because it was built on unstable soil/foundation; built mainly of white marble with limestone.
C – Venice: A city built on water with bridges and canals connecting the buildings; built on long wooden poles driven deep through the silt to a layer of hard clay.

questions.title: Sustainable and Responsible Tourism — Solar-Powered Airports

subQuestions.questionText: Refer to the 'SOLAR-POWERED AIRPORTS' extract about ACSA introducing solar power at Upington, George and Kimberley airports. Explain the concept of solar power.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answer (2 marks):
• Solar power uses sunlight to generate electricity.
• Solar panels capture sunlight and convert it into electricity that can power homes, buildings and other things.
• It is a clean and renewable energy source that helps reduce pollution and reliance on fossil fuels.

subQuestions.label: 8.1.2(a)
subQuestions.questionText: Complete the sentence below. The use of solar power is associated with the ... pillar of sustainability.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answer (2 marks): Environmental (planet)
• OR Economic (profit)

subQuestions.label: 8.1.2(b)
subQuestions.questionText: Name the other TWO pillars of sustainability.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (1 mark each): Social (people) and Economic (profit)
• OR Environmental (planet), depending on the answer given in 8.1.2(a).
NOTE: The pillar identified in 8.1.2(a) must not be repeated in 8.1.2(b).

subQuestions.questionText: Explain TWO advantages for airports of using solar power.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (any TWO — 2 marks each):
• It reduces the impact on the environment; solar power is a renewable and cost-effective resource.
• Airport operations will not be affected by load shedding.
• Solar energy is endless and produces no harmful pollutants when generating electricity.
• Using solar instead of fossil fuels reduces the carbon footprint.
• It preserves fossil fuels for the future and reduces environmental impact.
• It helps combat climate change, lessen air pollution and conserve natural resources.

subQuestions.questionText: ACSA's 2025 strategy is to 'become the most sought-after (in demand) partner in the world for the provision of sustainable airport management solutions'. Discuss TWO ways in which ACSA's 2025 strategy can contribute to Business operations.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (any TWO — 2 marks each):
• Reduces the business' reliance on fossil fuels through sustainable practices.
• Business operations can be cost-effective and partnerships with like-minded businesses can be fostered.
• Load shedding will not affect business operations.
• The use of energy-saving lighting and smart building technologies enhances the public image and competitive edge of the business.

subQuestions.questionText: Discuss TWO ways in which ACSA's 2025 strategy can contribute to Responsibility regarding climate change.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (any TWO — 2 marks each):
• Airports can use efficient technology that supports green initiatives.
• Use alternative fuels and electric vehicles on the tarmac and elsewhere at airports.
• Incorporate green initiatives at the airports, giving them a competitive edge.
• Enhancing environmental responsibility and awareness to climate change.

subQuestions.questionText: Refer to the 'BRICS IS EXPANDING' extract about the group of emerging countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa) that met in Russia in October 2023. Choose the correct word(s) from those given in brackets: BRICS can be classified as a (summit/political event).
subQuestions.memoText: Expected answer (2 marks): Summit

subQuestions.questionText: Discuss TWO ways in which the cooperation between BRICS member countries can provide opportunities to manage the energy crisis South Africa is experiencing currently.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (any TWO — 2 marks each):
• South Africa can develop trade relations with oil-rich nations, contributing to economic growth.
• These countries can assist in decreasing South Africa's reliance on fossil fuel sources.
• It can promote partnerships so that challenges can be solved.
• It can promote investment opportunities to increase economic growth.

subQuestions.questionText: Refer to the 'DEVASTATING FLOODS – SEPTEMBER 2023' article about Storm Daniel, which caused damage in Libya, Greece, Turkey and Bulgaria. Identify the type of unforeseen occurrence in the article above.

subQuestions.label: 9.2.2(a)
subQuestions.questionText: Explain how damage to infrastructure can affect communities' access to the following: Clean water.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answer (any ONE — 2 marks):
• Damage to water treatment or distribution facilities can lead to contamination of drinking water sources.
• Broken pipes can result in interruptions to the supply of clean water.
• It can affect the quality of water by allowing soil, debris or harmful substances to enter the water supply.

subQuestions.label: 9.2.2(b)
subQuestions.questionText: Explain how damage to infrastructure can affect communities' access to the following: Emergency aid.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answer (any ONE — 2 marks):
• Damage to infrastructure can delay emergency response efforts.
• It can cause communication problems and hinder the coordination of information between emergency responders.
• It can disrupt the delivery of emergency supplies to affected communities, leading to loss of lives.
• It can limit access for relief workers to provide aid.

subQuestions.questionText: Refer to the 'PAYMENT TRENDS – DIGITAL WALLETS' extract about e-wallets (e.g. Apple Pay, Google Pay). Discuss TWO advantages of using a digital wallet to pay for tourism products and services.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (any TWO — 2 marks each):
• The need for actual cards is eliminated, resulting in a convenient, quick and easy payment experience.
• Digital wallets allow for contactless and paperless payments globally.
• Customers prefer digital payment for security, convenience, tracking of expenditure and hygiene.
• Online shopping is made simple.
• Some digital payment apps offer rewards such as discounts, cashback or points.

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO reasons why cash is no longer a preferred method of payment.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (any TWO — 2 marks each):
• Using cash has become a security concern with the risk of theft or loss.
• Once lost/stolen it cannot be replaced.
• Some businesses do not accept cash, which lessens the receipt of counterfeit bank notes.
• Cash handling fees are high.
• Handling of cash is unhygienic.

questions.title: Communication and Customer Care — Customer Surveys

subQuestions.questionText: Refer to the 'CUSTOMER RESPONSES ... WHAT REALLY HAPPENS' information. Explain the meaning of the concept customer survey.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answer (any ONE — 2 marks):
• A customer survey is a method of collecting customer feedback.
• It helps companies identify areas of concern that need to be corrected or improved.
• It measures customer satisfaction after a tourism product or service has been used.
• A tool that measures the level of service experienced by customers.

subQuestions.questionText: By simply filing customer responses, the company will miss the opportunity to improve its products and services. Suggest TWO ways in which companies should manage customer responses to ensure better customer service.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (any TWO — 2 marks each):
• Analyse and capture the feedback to determine the level of service to customers.
• Group all the common complaints to identify the problem areas.
• Initiate the intervention process to implement the action plan.

subQuestions.questionText: Discuss TWO ways in which the use of customer surveys can result in improved customer satisfaction for the tourism business.
subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answers (any TWO — 2 marks each):
• Analysing the survey responses will assist the company in improving service delivery.
• The findings from the surveys will assist in developing an action plan to correct/improve products and services.
• Positive word of mouth will lead to an increased number of customers.
• Brand loyalty resulting in repeat customer visits to the tourism business.
